_about: How the computer chooses among legal actions (step 3e). Levels are presets of the levers below. No level gets hidden information, extra tokens or the Coach's Call target. Edit freely: computer.py reads everything from here.

defence._comfort_about: The defence concedes any look worth less than this (the Okay/Poor prestige boundary): it won't spend to push the offence below it. A level's comfort_offset is added.
defence._habits_not_about: habits_not: habits a level never draws. Rookie: not jumps_first_pass, since at Pass 14 v Intercept 6 an intercept attempt succeeds 60% of the time, so jumping passes is often right, not a beginner's mistake.

offence._patience_about: Shot bar by the clock (seconds left; a phase is two), step 3i: one curve on the shot's value after the reaction (the value already takes off the contest). A shot goes up only when it clears the bar and is worth at least what continuing is estimated to be worth; the bar drops each phase; at the last chance there is no bar.
offence._loop_about: loop_penalty: points off a non-shot play that ends where the offence already stood earlier this possession (its five squares and the ball), per earlier visit, up to three. shoot_by: from this clock on (Rookie: the phase before the last), the offence takes its best shot rather than keep building; 0 = only the last phase, which has no bar.
offence._pass_about: Step 3f. pass_risk_tolerance multiplies the -5 of a pick-off when a pass is valued (1.0 honest, below 1.0 reckless). pass_alternatives: what the level weighs against a contested pass, each valued with the next turn able to pass: receiver (a cut or relocation to open a lane), passer (move or dribble to change the angle), screen (a screen or seal), two_pass (two shorter clean passes). habits_not: forces_passes is a Rookie habit.
offence._plays_about: Step 3g. plays: the advantage plays the level knows (shoot, dribble attack, pass to move or finish an advantage, screen for a mismatch, speed burst, post seal, cut, and moving the advantage to the attacker the help left). advantage_depth: 1 = create only; 2 = create, the defence's best reply, then exploit.

_budget_about: Thinking time per decision (raised in step 3f: the designer prefers a slower, better choice). The browser build (Python compiled to the web) runs several times slower; the best choice found so far is used when time is up.

rookie: makes beginner mistakes you can learn to spot
starter: solid, with one habit to find

habit_words.always_force_middle: always pointed the on-ball arrow at the baseline, shading drives to the middle
habit_words.nearest_closes_out: always closed out with the nearest defender
habit_words.never_leaves_shooter: never left a ▲ three-point shooter, even when the look was poor
habit_words.ball_watcher: turned every help defender's arrow to the ball
habit_words.jumps_first_pass: tried to intercept every pass it could
habit_words.settles_early: lowered its shot bar a phase early, taking looks it could have waited on
habit_words.settles_for_first_shot: took the first look above a low bar
habit_words.ignores_mismatch: passed by position order, not by matchup
habit_words.star_only: always worked toward its highest-rated scorer
habit_words.forces_passes: passed to its primary target whenever it could, however well the lane was guarded

concept_words.reaction: didn't count the reaction to a declared shot
concept_words.reserve: didn't keep a reaction in hand
concept_words.lookahead: looked only at the shot on the board now
concept_words.help: didn't send help off the ball
concept_words.walls: didn't wall drives with the on-ball arrow
concept_words.lanes: didn't point arrows across passing lanes
concept_words.patience: didn't weigh waiting for a better shot
concept_words.drain: didn't work to drain the defence's reactions

_tuned: Head-to-head calibration (step 3e revised): see README 'How the computer plays' for every change and why.
_reply_about: Step 3i. reply_k: how many of the defence's replies the evaluation tries (plus 2). rotations: a help step and a switch or recover by another defender are always among them. offball_threat (defence): a teammate's catch after a pass counts in the defence's view of the offence's threat.
_goals_about: Step 3i. goals: the offence works a goal from goal_library.json (chain depth by level there). objectives: the defence ranks its objectives from what the offence could be building toward and adds plays that serve the top ones.
